title: 两条简单线选一条
description: 两位成人在地面观察两条颜色不同的低位大把手路线。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: Two fictional adults stand outside the padded area and compare two neighboring easy low routes, one using large coral holds and the other broad teal holds. The nearer adult turns toward the lower sequence, making a thoughtful choice without touching the wall. Keep both routes sparse and clearly separated, with obvious footholds close to the mat. Daylight, a plain seating bench, and calm body language make route selection an ordinary shared gym moment. Use etched-ink illustration with delicate controlled hatching, a few flat washes, and warm sepia balanced by pale turquoise. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
